Surely there should have been a message added to their automated message at the beginning of each call, to let patients know that today was for emergencies only?  It is hardly fair to withhold information such as this from patients.
There was not even a mention of it on their website.  I waited an hour for absolutely nothing.  At least it cost me nothing for the call.  But I would guess it cannot be the same for everyone.
Re. their callback system: I refuse to use it.  Twice I have done that, and twice I never received the call back.
